data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'mehlek', which means 'graceful' or 'delightful'. In Islamic tradition, it is believed that the name Mehlika is given to those who possess a gentle and elegant demeanor, and who bring joy and happiness to those around them. The name Mehlika carries the meaning “Graceful, Delightful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mehlika usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, delightful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
